versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-douyin-collect-public-outflow.

- Provides four CLI commands to collect public data from Douyin (keyword search, creator posts, video comments, trending topics).
- Triggers skill automatically based on intuitive user phrases related to Douyin or short video research, without requiring technical terms.
- Enforces strict token validation logic and output conventions for compliance and safety.
- Outputs results as structured JSON for easy analysis; logs are auto-saved per operation.
- Includes comprehensive usage scenarios, command reference, and error handling specifications.
